Tests are structural: no test executes a skill workflow end-to-end

recommendations.action: Populate outputs/capabilities for skills claiming artifacts, or amend ADR-001 to scope artifact-first to the core set
Reject empty outputs on skills that declare an artifactType
Pin a real revision/sourceType for released lockfile entries
Add one end-to-end fixture that executes a skill's steps

findings.statement: Empty capability sets produce no graph edges; skill-graph.mjs:30 states this and 227/266 skills are empty
Platform tooling is 87% of JavaScript LOC and concentrates 61 cross-directory imports in one directory
Editing a skill requires lockfile plus projection regeneration to keep tests green
45 categories are governed by 5 ADRs, none covering category boundaries

recommendations.action: Backfill capabilities for routing participants (12 core plus delivery and routing categories)
Add an ADR for category boundaries and the routing graph
Set a growth ceiling for platform/ and split validators from runtime before 50k LOC

overall.posture: Structurally sound and fully green on its own gates, but the declared v2 contract is realized in a minority of the bundle; viability is conditional on completing or formally retiring it.
overall.conflict_resolution: None required: Conditional (goals reachable) and Partial (delivery incomplete) describe different axes and were not reranked.
